name: com.cidonix.unibridge
description: Local MCP tools that let AI coding agents inspect, edit, capture, and validate Unity Editor projects through a per-project bridge and relay.

_upm.changelog:
### Added

- Reusable Unity53Legacy profile for Unity 5.3.2+ in the 5.3.x line, preserving all nine legacy tools and the build.19 relay.
- The compile matrix now includes Unity 5.3 with matching version symbols.

### Fixed

- ExposedReference serialized reads and writes compile only on Unity 5.6 and newer; ordinary typed object references remain available on Unity 5.3.

### Verified

- Compilation passes on Unity 5.3.2f1, 5.6.5f1, 5.6.7f1, 2017.4.6f1, and 2018.4.8f1.
- Live Unity 5.3.2f1 passed identity, hierarchy, DLL-backed component reads, asset search, three PNG capture paths, and temporary-scene write/readback/Undo/Redo with the original scene preserved.
